## TL;DR

- [1Password Environments][1]
- [NVIDIA OpenShell][6] and its [1Password integration][2]
- [Virtual Models][4] in [Pi][3]

## 1Password Environments

[1Password Environments][1] store a project's environment variables in 1Password instead of in `.env` files.

- tbd

## NVIDIA OpenShell

[NVIDIA OpenShell][6] is an open-source runtime that runs AI agents like Claude Code, Codex or OpenCode in sandboxes. Policies control which files and network hosts the agent can reach.

The [1Password integration][2] ([announcement][5]) hands secrets from an Environment to an OpenShell sandbox. The agent inside only ever sees placeholders, and OpenShell's gateway swaps in the real values for requests to hosts you approved.

- tbd

## Pi Virtual Models

[Virtual Models][4] in the [Pi][3] coding agent let you select a single model while a router picks the actual model for each request, for example a small model for quick questions and a large one for hard problems.

- tbd
